name: revyl
description: Check app changes on Revyl's web browsers, iOS simulators, Android emulators and macOS computers through the Revyl CLI, with screenshots and step results as evidence and Atlas as the record.

interface.longDescription: Use the Revyl CLI to run apps on web browsers, iOS simulators, Android emulators and macOS computers, inspect screenshots, validate behavior, and verify CI-uploaded pull request builds. Adds Revyl's hosted workspace tools for finding builds, driving devices and searching Atlas, and a session-start check of CLI sign-in, project configuration, and GitHub pull-request builds. Requires shell access and Revyl sign-in; the hosted tools sign in once with OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Run this app on a Revyl device and verify my change.
Verify this pull request using its CI-uploaded Revyl build.
